data.one_liner: A simple WebDAV client for Dart and Flutter supporting common file operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WebDAV client implementation supporting basic and digest authentication, directory listing, file uploads, downloads, and other standard WebDAV methods using Dio as the HTTP client.
use_when: You need to interact with a WebDAV server from your Dart or Flutter application.
You need to upload, download, copy, or manage files and directories on remote WebDAV storage.
avoid_when: You require a full cloud storage abstraction layer beyond basic WebDAV protocol features.
You are dealing with complex WebDAV extensions not covered by common methods.
strengths: Supports Basic and Digest authentication out of the box.
Provides stream-based file uploading and downloading with progress tracking.
weaknesses: Web platform support requires handling CORS issues manually.
Limited to common WebDAV methods as documented.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a powerful HTTP client for custom REST APIs instead of a dedicated WebDAV protocol client.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the standard lightweight Dart HTTP package for basic networking needs.
